data.title: Phuket vegetarian festival culminates Sunday night
data.description: PHUKET - This southern tourist island's nine-day vegetarian festival concludes on Sunday with closing parades throughout the day and a final ceremony at night.

data.title: Nida poll: Interior Ministry seen facing toughest censure grilling
data.description: The Interior Ministry is expected to face the toughest scrutiny in the coming no-confidence debate, according to a Nida Poll survey, with 45% of the respondents believing the opposition has solid evidence against the 18 targeted cabinet ministers.

data.title: ONE Championship: Chatri mocks Anpo with heavyweight jibe after hydration row
data.description: Chatri Sityodtong has hit back at Rukiya Anpo’s criticism of ONE Championship’s hydration testing, telling the Japanese kickboxer to take responsibility – and joking that he should fight at heavyweight.

data.title: ONE Championship: Haggerty explains US$100,000 Akimoto finish – ‘Do I start kneeing now?’
data.description: British champion Jonathan Haggerty asked his corner whether it was time to start kneeing Hiroki Akimoto – then delivered a third-round finish that earned him a US$100,000 bonus at ONE Samurai 4.

data.title: 'Never seen anything like it': mass looting grips Paris
data.description: PARIS - Smashing shop windows and snatching boxes of goods, migrant looters poured into stores across the French capital on Saturday, facing no resistance from authorities as nationwide protests degenerated into violence.

data.title: Chinese criminal fugitive arrested in Bangkok
data.description: A 37-year-old man wanted in China for alleged links to a transnational crime syndicate and money laundering has been arrested in Bangkok.

data.title: ONE Championship: Noiri rules out December Grigorian final after revealing injury
data.description: Masaaki Noiri has ruled out facing Marat Grigorian in December after revealing he fought through an injury to reach ONE Championship’s featherweight kickboxing tournament final.

data.title: Dutch embassy site’s three plots offer mixed-use potential
data.description: Bangkok’s Dutch embassy site offers mixed-use potential on rare freehold land, although buyers, a sale price and development plans remain unconfirmed.

data.title: Agents nab Chinese fugitive
data.description: A 37-year-old man wanted in China over alleged links to a transnational crime syndicate and money laundering has been arrested in Bangkok.

data.title: Probe into jumbo's death
data.description: Natural Resources and Environment Minister Suchart Chomklin has ordered an urgent investigation over the death of a wild elephant suspected of being electrocuted by an electric fence in Loei.

data.title: Nigerians held in drug sting
data.description: Immigration police have arrested two Nigerian men in Bangkok in a cocaine trafficking crackdown, seizing 103 grammes of the drug and equipment allegedly used to dilute it with chalk and baking soda.

data.title: Japan to launch historic round-trip mission to Mars moon
data.description: TOKYO - Japanese scientists are readying a mission to Mars's moons to retrieve samples that could help unlock the origins of the Solar System and life on Earth, in what aims to be the first round trip to the Martian region.

data.title: Your daily horoscope for Oct 18
data.description: The day of the week you were born on can reveal a lot... Read on. ✨= today's motto,⏰ = work, ₿ = money, ❤️= taken, ⚤ = single

data.title: Israeli settlers attack European diplomats, beat French mayor
data.description: JERUSALEM - Israeli settlers on Saturday attacked a convoy of European diplomats in the West Bank and beat up a visiting French mayor, witnesses said, a day after an American photographer was similarly set upon as violence escalates ahead of bitterly fought elections.

data.title: Town hall in Limoges 'largely lost' to blaze set during French protests
data.description: LIMOGES (FRANCE) - The town hall in the French city of Limoges was "largely lost" to a fire set by masked protesters on Saturday, the top regional official told AFP.

data.title: US goes on the offensive in central Asia
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - It's dealmaking time: despite the roiling geopolitical tensions embroiling Washington on several fronts, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio heads to Central and South Asia late Saturday to boost commercial ties -- and gain an edge over Russia and China.

data.title: Lamphun break winless run as Ayutthaya slump at their home
data.description: Lamphun Warriors picked up their first win of the season when they defeated Ayutthaya United 2-0 in the Thai League 1 at Ayutthaya Stadium on Friday night.

data.title: Pornpawee and doubles duo fall in Denmark
data.description: Pornpawee Chochuwong and the men's doubles pair Peeratchai Sukphun/Pakkapon Teeraratsakul bowed out in the quarter-finals of the US$950,000 BWF Denmark Open in Odense on Friday, ending Thai interest in the Super 750 event.

data.title: MRTA to review Hat Yai's monorail
data.description: The Mass Rapid Transit Authority of Thailand (MRTA) plans to review Hat Yai's monorail project next year, aiming to update a decade-old study to reflect new conditions and lessons from the 2025 major floods.

data.title: PCD probes Rangsit canal after fish deaths
data.description: The Pollution Control Department (PCD) is investigating pollution in Rangsit canal in Pathum Thani after mass fish deaths and reports of dark, foul-smelling water.

data.title: Economic challenges need global action
data.description: Thailand has called for stronger international cooperation to help economies navigate geopolitical tensions, rising energy costs and technological disruption, arguing that global partnerships must turn investment and innovation into tangible benefits for people and businesses.

data.title: Govt fleshes out energy transition plans
data.description: Thailand plans to accelerate its green transition by reducing energy import dependence, attracting private investment and strengthening climate resilience while creating jobs.

data.title: Rayong sweep uncovers 'unlicensed' karaoke spots
data.description: A raid on four karaoke venues in Rayong found that all were operating without entertainment licences, while two were suspected of concealing prostitution, the Interior Ministry said on Saturday.

data.title: Police trace 'cannabis' sweets
data.description: Police are tracing the source of online-purchased sweets suspected of containing cannabis after three family members, including a two-year-old boy, became seriously ill.

data.title: Pension reform needs good governance
data.description: Pension reforms should protect retirement savings while allowing funds to invest in domestic economies, with sound governance and returns for members remaining the top priorities, forum speakers said.

data.title: IMF helps members tackle 'modern risks'
data.description: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) is updating its Financial Sector Assessment Program (FSAP) to help member countries protect their financial systems against modern threats, including AI, cyberattacks, rising public debt and geopolitical tensions.

data.title: Ministry eyes illegal dumping
data.description: The Industry Ministry is pushing to establish dedicated recycling industrial estates to manage growing volumes of solar panel and electric vehicle (EV) battery waste, while tightening controls on hazardous industrial waste disposal.

data.title: Albanian capital sees fifth straight day of violent clashes
data.description: TIRANA (ALBANIA) - Albania's capital saw violent clashes for a fifth straight day on Saturday as police fired rubber bullets on protesters demanding the resignation of Prime Minister Edi Rama, who pledged to listen to their concerns.

data.title: Haaland stars in Man City win, Liverpool beat Brentford
data.description: LONDON - Erling Haaland starred with a double as Premier League leaders Manchester City beat Ipswich 3-2, while Liverpool came from behind to seal a 2-1 win at Brentford on Saturday.

data.title: Four more Ebola cases detected in Kenya, bringing total to seven
data.description: NAIROBI - Kenya has confirmed four new Ebola cases, the health ministry said Saturday, including another relative of the first victim and three healthcare workers who treated him.

data.title: Pope Leo leaves hospital five days after cancer surgery
data.description: VATICAN CITY - Pope Leo XIV left hospital on Saturday to return to the Vatican, five days after his lung cancer surgery.

data.title: Fifth day of violent clashes in Albanian capital
data.description: TIRANA - Albania’s capital saw clashes for a fifth straight day Saturday as protesters demanded the resignation of Prime Minister Edi Rama, who pledged to listen to their criticism.
